title: A rapid assay for the biological evaluation of helicase activity.
protocol: Setup the annealing reaction with oligonucleotides, HEPES, NaCl, EDTA, SDS.
Heat the oligonucleotide mix at 100°C for 5 min.
Incubate the mixture at 65°C for 30 min.
Incubate the mixture at 22°C for 4 h to allow gradual annealing.
Store the annealed NS3 helicase substrate at -20°C.
Prepare a stock solution of neutravidin at a final concentration of 1 mg/ml in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) pH 7.0.
Coat each well of 96-well plates overnight at 4°C with 100 μl/well of a 5 μg/ml neutravidin solution in 0.5 M sodium carbonate buffer pH 9.3.
Wash the wells three times with 100 μl/well of PBS and air-dry at room temperature.
Block the wells with 100 μl of a 0.1% (w/v) BSA solution followed by incubation at 22°C for 2 h.
Wash each well three times with 200 μl/well of PBS, then air-dry and store plates at 4°C with desiccant.
Mix 75 μl of 1 M phosphate buffer (PBS) pH 7.0 containing 1 M NaCl with 2.5 ng of the partially annealed DNA duplex for each well.
Incubate the mixture at 22°C for 4 h.
Wash each well twice with 200 μl PBS and once with 200 μl of 50 mM Tris HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl.
Pre-warm all solutions to 37°C before use.
Initiate helicase reactions by adding 90 μl of reaction mix to wells containing 2.5 ng of DNA substrate.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 60 min at 37°C.
Wash the wells twice with 200 μl of 150 mM NaCl.
Dry the wells at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash the wells of the multi-well plate for 5 min with detection washing buffer \(0.1 M maleic acid, 0.15 M NaCl, 0.3%, Tween20, pH 7.5).
Fill each well up with blocking solution \(10% BSA \(w/v) in 0.1 M maleic acid, 0.15 M NaCl, pH 7.5) for 30 min.
Incubate each well in 20 μl of antibody solution (anti-Dig, Roche, 1:10,000 solution -75 mU/ml- in blocking solution) for 30 min.
Wash the wells twice with 100 μl of detection buffer \(0.1 M Tris-HCl, 0.1 M NaCl, pH 9.5).
Apply 20 μl of detection buffer to each well for equilibration.
Add 1 μl of chemiluminescence substrate (CSPD – 0.25 mM) working solution to each well and incubate at 17°C for 5 min.
Drain the wells.
Incubate the drained wells at 37°C for 30 min to allow any remaining solution to evaporate.
Fill the wells completely with blocking solution during the blocking step.
Pre-warm all solutions before use to ensure optimal reaction temperatures.
Ensure that all potential binding sites are occupied by the blocking solution.
Completely fill reaction wells with blocking solution to prevent non-specific binding.
